description: OutboundRule is polymorphic on `type` (FQDN, PrivateEndpoint, ServiceTag); the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the subtype `destination` on encode and decode. Add it as an untyped document to the input and output shapes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Rule destination (polymorphic on `type`): an FQDN string, a `{ serviceResourceId, subresourceTarget }` private endpoint target, or a `{ serviceTag, protocol, portRanges, action }` service tag.
